nodes.text: Something's set up shop on my fourteen miles, uninvited. I keep a ledger of who works this road. They're not in it.
There's your mark. The post can't leave the lamp, so the errand's yours. Bring me back a shorter ledger.
Chart holds the mark. My patience holds less.
Fires say brigand, tracks say more than four. Past that I'd be inventing, and I don't invent on the road.
Then walk the middle of the road and don't stop to look.
